description:
[read-only] Checks a hook, CTA, caption or ad against the brand's claims sources (verified prices, banned phrases, competitors, destinations). No model call, nothing stored, free. Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/hook-studio/claims/check.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.
